title: The Nervous System
core_thesis: The real-time nervous system acts as a deterministic, isolated hardware arbiter that translates statistical, multi-rate neural policy proposals into safe, continuous physical actuation limits.
pedagogical_strengths: Clearly contrasting empirical latency distributions against structural timing guarantees.
Grounding computational execution cadences directly in physical realities like winding time constants and braking distances.

student_friction_points.point: The Response Time Analysis formula ($R_i = C_i + B_i + I_i \le D_i$) appears in the summary takeaways without prior narrative unpacking of its computational, blocking, and interference terms.
The '5x5 Handoffs-by-Limits Grid' is introduced abruptly in the takeaways; this heavy conceptual matrix needs foreshadowing earlier in the chapter to avoid overwhelming the reader.

established_budgets_and_laws: Execution frequencies dictated by physical winding time constants ($\tau_e = L/R$).
Watchdog lease durations mathematically bounded by physical braking distances ($d_{\text{stop}} \le D_{\text{clear}}$).
imported_prerequisites: The proposal-permission architecture and causal boundaries (@sec-boundary).
Physical plant constraints and actuator thermal limits (@sec-body-five-budgets).
exported_concepts: Time-bounded intent leases as a safety mechanism for untrusted high-level compute.
Hardware privilege boundaries restricting actuator write access exclusively to the deterministic enforcer.

surgical_edits.target_text: This inference is invalid. An empirical distribution is a record of what happened under a finite sequence of test conditions, whereas a hard real-time guarantee is a proof of what can happen under all legal states of the hardware.
surgical_edits.improved_text: This inference is fatally flawed. An empirical distribution merely records what happened during finite testing, whereas a hard real-time guarantee mathematically proves what must happen under all possible hardware states.

surgical_edits.target_text: When control software delegates safety to statistical policies, any operating system preemption or memory paging stall immediately converts into uncommanded kinetic drift.
surgical_edits.improved_text: When control software delegates safety directly to statistical neural policies, any operating system preemption or memory stall instantly degrades into uncommanded kinetic drift.

open_thematic_threads_for_part: How does the deterministic hardware container built in Part I handle the noisy, out-of-distribution physical interaction data required for the closed-loop learning discussed in Part II?
